summary: The demonstration proves a two-step TextEdit workflow: invoke Cmd+N to create a new document window, then enter caller-supplied text into that new document’s “First Text View.” The input parameter is variable; the literal body was not demonstrated. This matches the feedback: it creates a new document rather than replacing an existing note.
lessons: Preserve the Cmd+N new-window step so each run starts a new TextEdit document.
Treat the note body as a runtime input parameter, not fixed text.
Use the newly created document’s “First Text View” as the input target.
